items.title: DUOL Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong User Growth
items.summary: Duolingo beat Q2 estimates as revenues, daily users and paid subscribers grow, while lower AI costs support a higher profitability outlook.

items.title: ZETA Gains 6% Since Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
items.summary: Zeta Global's Q2 revenues jump 43.5% as AI adoption, customer growth, and platform usage fuel results and a stronger outlook for 2026.

items.title: Spotify Q2 Earnings Miss on Higher Marketing and AI Costs
items.summary: SPOT's Q2 earnings miss estimates as higher marketing, cloud and AI costs offset record margins, subscriber gains and stronger cash flow.

items.title: FTI Consulting Stock Declines 4.1% Since Q2 Earnings Beat
items.summary: FCN beats second-quarter earnings estimates and reaffirms revenue guidance. Its rising costs squeeze margins and send shares lower.

items.title: Is Palantir Stock a Buy After Yet Another Blowout Quarter?
items.summary: PLTR's record revenue growth, soaring profits, and stronger bookings fuel its AI momentum, while high expectations and rising costs temper the outlook.

items.title: Aptiv's Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Year Over Year
items.summary: APTV beats Q2 earnings estimates despite revenue miss, as margin gains, new commercial awards and regional strength offset a lowered 2026 outlook.

items.title: Broadridge's Q4 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Increase Y/Y
items.summary: BR's fiscal fourth-quarter earnings and revenues top estimates as recurring revenues, closed sales and GTO profitability strengthen.

items.title: Caterpillar stock surges on data center boom: How the AI trade is expanding
items.summary: Caterpillar's (CAT) second quarter earnings results beat Wall Street's expectations. Morning Brief host Julie Hyman chats with Business Insider executive editor Dan DeFrancesco and Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley about the results and the expansive AI industry.
